children: The People's Bank of China conducted RMB 5 billion of 7-day reverse repos today at an unchanged rate of 1.4%, according to ETNet.

RMB 5 billion of reverse repos matured in the open market today, leaving a net drain of RMB 4.5 billion. The central bank also said it would roll over RMB 500 billion of 3-month buyout reverse repos today, matching the amount due. The operation matures on December 5, 2026, or the next business day if that falls on a holiday.

title: PBOC Conducts RMB 5 Billion 7-Day Reverse Repo At 1.4%
